instruction: Configure GIMP to show the GIMP tip on startup by enabling the 'Show tip on startup' option.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate to GIMP preferences and enable the show tips on startup option. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for 'show-tips yes'. Uses existing check_config_status metric and get_gimp_config_file getter.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if show-tips is set to yes, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GIMP configuration from gimprc file at ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric correctly parses gimprc and checks for key-value pair 'show-tips yes'
Expected value 'show-tips: yes' is semantically correct for enabling tips on startup
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config is written to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement stated in instruction
Logic flow is sound and will work correctly at runtime
